related_questions.question: What is the maximum marriage allowance?
related_questions.snippet: Marriage Allowance lets you transfer £1,260 of your Personal Allowance to your husband, wife or civil partner. Your Personal Allowance is the amount you can earn before paying tax. This reduces their tax by up to £252 in the tax year (6 April to 5 April the next year). This guide is also available in Welsh (Cymraeg).

related_questions.question: How does getting married affect taxes?
related_questions.snippet: When two individuals get married and decide to file jointly, their standard deductions combine, and their Married Filing Jointly standard deduction becomes $25,900 for 2022's taxes. So, the standard deduction for a married couple is not “higher”; it is the combination of the two single individuals' standard deductions.
